UPDATE yh_jz_service_person
service_state=#{state},
start_service_time=#{begintime},
acceptsituation=#{acceptsituation},
end_service_time=#{endtime},
satisfaction=#{satisfaction},
returnvisit = #{returnvisit,jdbcType=INTEGER}
WHERE id=#{id};
mapper.select: SELECT tp.tid, re.`name`, tp.doctor_code, re.birth_date, a.id, a.service_subtitle, a.insert_time, setype.service_name, sas.`name` AS cname FROM yh_jz_service_person AS a LEFT JOIN yh_jz_service_type setype ON a.service_type = setype.id LEFT JOIN yh_jz_service_assessment_switch sas ON sas.id = a.childnodes LEFT JOIN yh_jz_service_total_person AS tp ON tp.user_code = a.user_code LEFT JOIN yh_user_reginfo re ON tp.user_code = re.user_code WHERE a.isrede = 1 AND tp.doctor_code = #{usercode} ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 10
